_readme: Tools on the separate apps site (site.json > apps_url, PR #8 apps/). 'articles': article slugs that link the tool in their 'Free tools for this' box (at most 2 apps tools per article are shown). /tools/ lists every tool by group. Hidden when apps_url is empty.

tools.title: Paycheck calculator by state
tools.blurb: take-home pay after 2026 federal and state tax, for all 50 states and DC.

tools.title: Roth vs traditional calculator
tools.blurb: compare Roth and traditional IRA or 401(k) contributions at your tax rates.

tools.title: Can I afford it?
tools.blurb: a car, a phone or anything big: cash vs loan vs buy now, pay later, and how it fits your month.

tools.title: Subscription audit
tools.blurb: find every recurring charge in a bank statement and what it costs a year.

tools.title: Bill negotiation tracker
tools.blurb: bills, promo end dates and call scripts to lower them yourself.

tools.title: 0% deal countdown
tools.blurb: the payment that clears a 0% or deferred-interest deal in time.

tools.title: Emergency fund calculator
tools.blurb: how much to save and how long it takes at your pace.

tools.title: High-yield savings calculator
tools.blurb: how much interest a savings account pays on your balance.

tools.title: Student loan repayment chooser
tools.blurb: compare 2026 federal repayment plans on your balance and income.

tools.title: Credit card minimum payment calculator
tools.blurb: how long minimum payments take and what they cost.

tools.title: Credit dispute tracker
tools.blurb: track 30-day credit bureau deadlines for a report error.

tools.title: Medical bill letters
tools.blurb: request an itemized bill, dispute an error or ask for financial assistance.

tools.title: Debt collector letters
tools.blurb: debt validation and stop-contact letters.

tools.title: Rent vs buy calculator
tools.blurb: owning costs vs renting and investing the difference, with the break-even year.

tools.title: Net worth tracker
tools.blurb: what you own minus what you owe, with dated snapshots and a trend.

tools.title: Compound interest calculator
tools.blurb: how monthly contributions grow over time.

tools.title: 401(k) fee checker
tools.blurb: what your funds' expense ratios cost in dollars.

tools.title: The 20-Minute Budget app
tools.blurb: a free, private budget app that runs in your browser.

tools.title: Rate My Budget
tools.blurb: a budget score in 2 minutes and three next moves.

tools.title: Holiday spending planner
tools.blurb: gift list, per-person budgets and the real cost of pay-in-4.
